info.title: carbon
info.description: The `carbon` command-line tool for developing and building DotCarbon desktop apps.

options.name: --version
options.description: Show version information

options.description: Show help and usage information

commands.name: dev
commands.description: Start Carbon in development mode (desktop)

options.name: --project
options.description: Path to the Carbon project (default: current directory)

options.name: --no-types
options.description: Do not generate ui/src/carbon.d.ts while dev mode is running

options.name: --types-out
options.description: Output path for generated TypeScript declarations (default: ui/src/carbon.d.ts)

options.name: --no-capabilities
options.description: Do not sync discovered commands into src-carbon/capabilities/main.json

options.name: --no-watch
options.description: Run the .NET host once instead of rebuilding on C# changes (dotnet watch)

commands.name: bundle
commands.description: Package a Carbon app for a platform target

commands.name: desktop
commands.description: Bundle for macOS, Windows, or Linux

options.name: --project
options.description: Path to the Carbon project (default: current directory)

options.name: --target
options.description: Runtime target (osx-arm64, osx-x64, osx-universal, win-x64, linux-x64, …)

options.name: --aot
options.description: Use NativeAOT (experimental; Photino's native library remains a second file)

options.name: --no-package
options.description: Publish the self-contained executable only; skip the installer

options.name: --updater-artifacts
options.description: Create and sign updater metadata (requires CARBON_UPDATER_PRIVATE_KEY)

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: Print the bundle plan without executing it
